svg.aria-label: Two graphs. (a) The left side of Lemma C.19 (3) against s from minus 5/8 to 2/3, for d = 1/2, 2/3 and pi over 4: each curve has a corner at s = 0 and a least value, marked, at s = d, or at s = 2/3 for d = pi over 4, all positive. (b) The least value over s against d from 1/2 to pi over 4, about 0.034 at 1/2, 0.019 at 2/3 and 0.047 at pi over 4, with the dashed bound of the proof just below it
